summary: This program checks a player's level number against a cascade of conditions and prints the matching skill tier. With the number set to 12, it prints "Intermediate Level".

lines.text: The player's level is fixed here so you can see the middle branch fire; change it to 5 or 25 and rerun to watch a different tier print.
The first condition is tested first, and only if it fails does Java move on to the next clause. Order matters, because the cascade stops at the first match.
The else-if adds a second criterion to check before falling through to the default. Note that it does not need to say "10 or more": reaching this line already means the first condition was false.
The else is the default plan for when none of the conditions match, so exactly one of these three messages always prints.
